definition: The digits of a number counted from its first non-zero digit, so $0.0407$ has $3$ significant figures; zeros between non-zero digits count, and so does a zero kept at the end after rounding ($5.70$); IB answers are exact or given to $3$ significant figures unless the question says otherwise.

For a value rounded to the nearest $u$, the rounded value plus $\frac{u}{2}$, which the true value is strictly less than ($7.3$ to $1$ d.p. has upper bound $7.35$); in graph theory, a value that the length of the shortest travelling salesman tour cannot be greater than.

For a value rounded to the nearest $u$, the rounded value minus $\frac{u}{2}$, which the true value can equal ($7.3$ to $1$ d.p. has lower bound $7.25$); in graph theory, a value that the length of the shortest travelling salesman tour cannot be less than.

How far an approximate value $v_{A}$ is from the exact value $v_{E}$, as a percentage of the exact value: $\left|\frac{v_{A} - v_{E}}{v_{E}}\right| \times 100\%$; always divide by the exact value, never by the approximation.
